title: Fats Pierce and Piron's band
summary: Recollections of pianist Fats jamming at his house, friend Al Corliss, and a violinist at Tranchina's identified as Piron's band.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Fats P. Well, Fats was coming up around in them days. Many times I went to Fats' house. He and I used to get together on the piano and trumpet. That's how long I know Fats. There used to be another friend of mine by the name of Al Corliss that played piano. That's a good friend of mine. He's in Steamship business today. He was a fine piano player too. But we used to like Fats. We used to like to hear Fats play. So we'd go call up Fats and go down to his house. Sit around, drink some coffee and start jamming. I don't know. But, well, Fats played with all different bands in them days. I don't know if Fats played with, there used to be a violin player. It used to play out the lake years ago in a place called Tranchina. He had a nice band out there too for years. I can't think of that man's name now. He was on the end of my time. He was a very good...
Was that Peter Boccaz who was a corner player in that band?
Where, where? Out of the lake.
Do you know him? Real like that.
I was thinking of Piron's band.
Piron's the band I'm thinking about. Yeah, that's the band I'm thinking about. Piron.
